card.name: Word 'history' after 'with' in contraindications
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "history" right after "with", "and" or "or" in contraindication lists, where the article "a" is missing ("with history of"). Also fires on "case" in "in case of".

modes.label: History without an article
modes.description: The word "history" in a contraindication list where "a" is dropped, before "of".
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS THYMOGLOBULIN is contraindicated in patients with<< history>> of allergy or anaphylactic reaction

modes.label: Missing-article spots
modes.description: A noun or verb in a clipped phrase where an article or similar small word is left out, such as "in case of".
